credentials.name: FCC General Radiotelephone Operator License (GROL)
credentials.exam_elements: Written Elements 1 and 3 (47 CFR 13.201(b)). Element 1: basic radio law and operating practice. Element 3: electronic fundamentals and techniques to adjust, repair and maintain radio transmitters and receivers at FCC-licensed stations in the aviation and maritime radio services (47 CFR 13.203).
credentials.eligibility: Any person legally eligible for employment in the United States (47 CFR 13.9(a)(1)). Applications on FCC Form 605 (13.9(b)).
credentials.term: Normally valid for the lifetime of the holder (47 CFR 13.15).
credentials.fcc_fee_source: 47 CFR 1.1102(c) Table 2, personal license application, new license $35; Commercial Radio Operator licenses named as personal licenses. ETA's FCC page also states the FCC added a $35 fee for new commercial operator applications.
credentials.exam_administered_by: COLEMs (Commercial Operator License Examination Managers); fees set by each COLEM (47 CFR 13.217 records rule for COLEMs recovering fees).

colem_exam_fees.fee: $50 one element; $50 any two elements together; $25 each additional element same sitting; excludes FCC fee

credentials.typical_total_cost_usd: About $85 (ETA: $50 for Elements 1+3 in one sitting, plus $35 FCC fee). NMEA route about $135. Derived from the fees above.
credentials.mapping_note: Not named in any CFETP edition opened. AF COOL listing UNVERIFIED (site unreachable).

endorsement.name: Ship Radar Endorsement
endorsement.requirement: Written Element 8 (47 CFR 13.201(b)(7)); may be added to GROL (13.7(c)(1)). Element 8 covers installation, servicing and maintenance of ship radar for marine navigation (13.203).
endorsement.exam_fee: ETA: $25 if taken with Elements 1+3 at the same sitting; NMEA: $50
endorsement.fcc_fee: UNVERIFIED whether a separate $35 FCC fee applies to adding an endorsement
endorsement.relevance: Marine radar specific; weak relevance to aircraft avionics (inferred)

credentials.name: IPC J-STD-001 Certified IPC Specialist (CIS) - Requirements for Soldered Electrical and Electronic Assemblies
credentials.how_obtained: Training plus certification exams through IPC certification partners / training centers (IPC page links a 'database of certification partners'). Specialists are certified to the criteria; training others requires the separate CIT credential.
credentials.validity: 2 years; renew within 6 months before expiration; renewed cert runs 2 years from the prior expiration date (https://edhelp.ipc.org/certification/can-i-extend-my-certification-past-expiration)

cost_examples.price: GBP 775 certification (3.5 days); GBP 715 recertification (3 days); GBP 1,250 one-day challenge test

credentials.official_ipc_price: UNVERIFIED (none published on opened IPC pages)
credentials.candidates_per_ipc: Assembly process engineers, quality assurance supervisors, training managers and others responsible for the quality and reliability of soldered electronic assemblies
